Las referencias revelan enfoques modernos vitales para comprender, crear y evaluar los datos obtenidos a lo largo de las diversas etapas del diseño y análisis de ensayos clínicos.

Accesible y completo, el primer volumen en un conjunto de dos partes incluye artículos recién escritos, así como literatura establecida de la Enciclopedia Wiley de ensayos clínicos. Ilustrando una variedad de conceptos y principios estadísticos tales como datos longitudinales, datos faltantes, covaria, aleatorización biasada, mediciones repetidas y aleatorización sencilla, el libro también proporciona una cobertura detallada de los diversos diseños de ensayo encontrados en los ensayos de fase I-IV. Métodos y aplicaciones de la estadística en ensayos clínicos, Volumen 1: Conceptos, Principios, Pruebas y Diseños también características:

Capítulos detallados sobre el tipo de diseños de ensayo, tales como adaptive, crossover, agrupa-randomized, multicenter, non-inferiority, non-randomized, open-labeled, preference, prevention, and superiority trials

Más de 100 contribuciones de académicos, investigadores y profesionales líderes

Una exploración de ensayos clínicos en curso y avanzados sobre cáncer temprano y enfermedades cardíacas, ensayos de transmisión de virus de inmunodeficiencia humana maternoinfantil y el grupo de ensayos clínicos sobre el SIDA

Métodos y aplicaciones de la estadística en ensayos clínicos, Volumen 1: Conceptos, Principios, Pruebas y Diseños es una excelente referencia para investigadores, profesionales y estudiantes en los campos de clínicas, farmaceuticas, bioestadística, diseño de investigación médica, biología, biomedicina, epidemiología y salud pública.

title: Indexing
description:
Indexing consists of both novel and more traditional techniques. Cutting-edge indexing techniques, such as automatic indexing, ontologies, and topic maps, were developed independently of older techniques such as thesauri, but it is now recognized that these older methods also hold expertise.Indexing describes various traditional and novel indexing techniques, giving information professionals and students of library and information sciences a broad and comprehensible introduction to indexing. This title consists of twelve chapters: an Introduction to subject readings and theasauri; Automatic indexing versus manual indexing; Techniques applied in automatic indexing of text material; Automatic indexing of images; The black art of indexing moving images; Automatic indexing of music; Taxonomies and ontologies; Metadata formats and indexing; Tagging; Topic maps; Indexing the web; and The Semantic Web.
Makes difficult and complex techniques understandable
Contains may links to and illustrations from websites where new indexing techniques can be experienced
Provides references for further reading
translatedDescription:
La indexación consiste tanto en técnicas novedosas como tradicionales. Las técnicas de indexación de bordes de corte, como la indexación automática, las ontologías y los mapas de temas, se desarrollaron independientemente de técnicas antiguas como tesauro, pero ahora se reconoce que estos métodos antiguos también tienen experiencia. La indexación describe diversas técnicas tradicionales y novedosas de indexación, dando a los profesionales de la información y a los estudiantes de biblioteca y ciencias de la información una introducción amplia y comprensible a la indexación. Este título consta de doce capítulos: una Introducción a las lecturas subjetivas y theasauri; Indización automática contra indización manual; Técnicas aplicadas en indización automática del material de texto; Indización automática de imágenes; El arte negro de indexar imágenes móviles; Indización automática de la música; Taxonomías e ontologías; formatos de metadatos e indexación; etiquetado; mapas temáticos; indexación de la web; y La Web Semántica.
Hace comprensibles técnicas difíciles y complejas
Contiene enlaces e ilustraciones de sitios web donde se pueden experimentar nuevas técnicas de indexación
Proporciona referencias para la lectura posterior

title: Joe Celko's Trees and Hierarchies in SQL for Smarties, 2nd Edition

The demand for SQL information and training continues to grow with the need for a database behind every website capable of offering web-based information queries. Expert advice from a noted SQL authority and award-winning columnist who has given 10 years of service to the ANSI SQL standards committee
Teaches scores of advanced techniques that can be used with any product, in any SQL environment

title: Sample Size Calculations for Clustered and Longitudinal Outcomes in Clinical Research
description: This book explains how to determine sample size for studies with correlated outcomes, which are widely implemented in medical, epidemiological, and behavioral studies. For clustered studies, the authors provide sample size formulas that account for variable cluster sizes and within-cluster correlation. For longitudinal studies, they present sample size formulas that account for within-subject correlation among repeated measurements and various missing data patterns. For multiple levels of clustering, the authors describe how randomization impacts trial administration, analysis, and sample size requirement.
translatedDescription: Este libro explica cómo determinar el tamaño de la muestra para estudios con resultados correlativos, que son ampliamente implementados en estudios médicos, epidemiológicos y conductuales. Para estudios agrupados, los autores proporcionan fórmulas de tamaño muestral que explican tamaños de racimo variables y correlación entre componentes. Para estudios longitudinales, presentan fórmulas de tamaño muestral que explican la correlación entre mediciones repetidas y diversos patrones de datos perdidos. Para múltiples niveles de agrupación, los autores describen cómo afecta la aleatorización a la administración, el análisis y el requisito del tamaño de la muestra.

title: Variational Methods for Engineers with Matlab
description:
This book is issued from a 30 years’ experience on the presentation of variational methods to successive generations of students and researchers in Engineering. It gives a comprehensive, pedagogical and engineer-oriented presentation of the foundations of variational methods and of their use in numerical problems of Engineering. Particular applications to linear and nonlinear systems of equations, differential equations, optimization and control are presented. MATLAB programs illustrate the implementation and make the book suitable as a textbook and for self-study.

The evolution of knowledge, of the engineering studies and of the society in general has led to a change of focus from students and researchers. New generations of students and researchers do not have the same relations to mathematics as the previous ones. In the particular case of variational methods, the presentations used in the past are not adapted to the previous knowledge, the language and the centers of interest of the new generations. Since these methods remain a core knowledge – thus essential - in many fields (Physics, Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Economics, Image analysis …), a new presentation is necessary in order to address variational methods to the actual context.
translatedDescription:
Este libro se publica desde una experiencia de 30 años sobre la presentación de métodos de variación a generaciones sucesivas de estudiantes e investigadores en Ingeniería. Ofrece una presentación integral, pedagógica y orientada al ingeniero de los fundamentos de los métodos de variación y de su uso en problemas numéricos de Ingeniería. Se presentan aplicaciones especiales para sistemas lineales y no lineales de ecuaciones, ecuaciones diferenciales, optimización y control. Los programas de MATLAB ilustran la implementación y hacen que el libro sea adecuado como un libro de texto y para la auto-estudio.

La evolución del conocimiento, de los estudios de ingeniería y de la sociedad en general ha llevado a un cambio de enfoque de estudiantes e investigadores. Las nuevas generaciones de estudiantes e investigadores no tienen las mismas relaciones con las matemáticas que las anteriores. En el caso particular de métodos de variación, las presentaciones utilizadas en el pasado no se adaptan al conocimiento previo, el lenguaje y los centros de interés de las nuevas generaciones. Puesto que estos métodos siguen siendo un conocimiento básico – por lo tanto esencial – en muchos campos (Physics, Engineering, Matemática Aplicada, Economía, Análisis de imagen ...), es necesario una nueva presentación para abordar métodos de variación al contexto real.

title: Designing Data Visualizations
description:
Data visualization is an efficient and effective medium for communicating large amounts of information, but the design process can often seem like an unexplainable creative endeavor. This concise book aims to demystify the design process by showing you how to use a linear decision-making process to encode your information visually.

Delve into different kinds of visualization, including infographics and visual art, and explore the influences at work in each one. Then learn how to apply these concepts to your design process.

Learn data visualization classifications, including explanatory, exploratory, and hybrid
Discover how three fundamental influences—the designer, the reader, and the data—shape what you create
Learn how to describe the specific goal of your visualization and identify the supporting data
Decide the spatial position of your visual entities with axes
Encode the various dimensions of your data with appropriate visual properties, such as shape and color
See visualization best practices and suggestions for encoding various specific data types
translatedDescription:

Desarrollar en diferentes tipos de visualización, incluyendo infografías y arte visual, y explorar las influencias en el trabajo en cada uno. A continuación, aprenda a aplicar estos conceptos a su proceso de diseño.

Clases de visualización de datos, incluyendo explicativo, exploratorio e híbrido

title: End-to-end Integration with IBM Sterling B2B Integration and Managed File Transfer solutions
description:
Across numerous vertical industries, enterprises are challenged to improve processing efficiency as transactions flow from their business communities to their internal systems and vice versa, simplify management and expansion of the external communities, accommodate customer and supplier preferences, govern the flow of information, enforce policy and standards, and protect sensitive information. Throughout this process, external partners must be on-boarded and off-boarded, information must flow across multiple communications infrastructures, and data must be mapped and transformed for consumption across multiple applications.

Some transactions require synchronous or real-time processing while others are of a more periodic nature. For some classes of customer or supplier, the enterprise might prefer a locally-managed, on-premise solution. For some types of communities (often small businesses), an as-a-Service solution might be the best option. Many large enterprises combine the on-premise and as-a-Service approach to serve different categories of business partners (customers or suppliers).

This IBM® Redbooks® publication focuses on solutions for end-to-end integration in complex value chains and presents several end-to-end common integration scenarios with IBM Sterling and IBM WebSphere® portfolios.

We believe that this publication will be a reference for IT Specialists and IT Architects implementing an integration solution architecture involving IBM Sterling and IBM WebSphere portfolios.

Please note that the additional material referenced in the text is not available from IBM.

A lo largo de este proceso, los socios externos deben estar a bordo y fuera de bordo, la información debe fluir a través de múltiples infraestructuras de comunicaciones, y los datos deben ser mapeados y transformados para el consumo en múltiples aplicaciones.

Algunas transacciones requieren procesamiento sincronizado o en tiempo real, mientras que otras son de carácter más periódico. Para algunas clases de cliente o proveedor, la empresa podría preferir una solución localmente gestionada, en premisa. Para algunos tipos de comunidades (a menudo pequeñas empresas), una solución como servicio podría ser la mejor opción. Muchas grandes empresas combinan el enfoque basado en la premisa y como servicio para servir a diferentes categorías de socios comerciales (clientes o proveedores).

Esta publicación IBM® Redbooks® se centra en soluciones para la integración de extremo a extremo en cadenas de valor complejas y presenta varios escenarios de integración común de extremo a extremo con carteras IBM Sterling e IBM WebSphere®.

Creemos que esta publicación será una referencia para los especialistas de TI y los arquitectos de TI que implementan una arquitectura de solución de integración que involucra carteras de IBM Sterling e IBM WebSphere.

title: Hibernate Search in Action
description:
Hibernate Search in Action is a practical, example-oriented guide for Java developers with some background in Hibernate Core. As the first book to cover Hibernate Search, it guides you through every step to set up full text search functionality in your Java applications. The book also introduces core search techniques and reviews the relevant parts of Lucene, in particular the query capabilities.

Hibernate Search in Action also provides a pragmatic, how-to exploration of more advanced topics such as Search clustering. For anyone using Hibernate or JBoss Seam, this book is the definitive guide on how to add or enhance search features in their applications.

About the Technology

Good search capability is one of the primary demands of a business application. Engines like Lucene provide a great starting point, but with complex applications it can be tricky to implement. It's tough to keep the index up to date, deal with the mismatch between the index structure and the domain model, handle querying conflicts, and so on.

Hibernate Search is an enterprise search tool based on Hibernate Core and Apache Lucene. It provides full text search capabilities for Hibernate-based applications without the infrastructural code required by other search engines. With this free, open-source technology, you can quickly add high-powered search features in an intelligent, maintainable way.

About the BookWhat's InsideAbout the ReaderAbout the Author

Emmanuel Bernard: After graduating from Supelec (French "Grande Ecole"), Emmanuel has spent a few years in the retail industry where he started to be involved in the ORM space and in full text technology. He joined the Hibernate team in 2003 and is now a lead developer at JBoss, a division of Red Hat. Emmanuel is the lead developer of Hibernate Annotations and Hibernate EntityManager, two key projects on top of Hibernate core implementing the Java Persistence(tm) specification. He has also lead the Hibernate Search project from its inception, reconsiling the two fields Emmanuel has been involved in: ORM and Full Text search. He is a regular speaker at various conferences and JUGs, including JavaOne, JBoss World and Javapolis (Javoxx). He is also involved in the Java Community Process as a specification lead for JSR 303 (Bean Validation) and as a expert group member for JSR 317 (Java Persistence 2.0).

John Griffin has been in the software and computer industry in one form or another since 1969. He remembers writing his first FORTRAN IV program on his way back from Woodstock. Currently, he is the software engineer/architect for SOS Staffing Services, Inc. He was formerly the lead e-commerce architect for Iomega Corporation, lead SOA architect for Realm Systems and an independent consultant for the Dept of the Interior among many other callings. John has even spent time as an adjunct university professor. He enjoys being a committer to projects because he believes it's time to get involved and give back to the community. John is the author of XML and SQL Server 2000 published by New Riders Press. He is a member of the ACM. Currently, he resides in Layton, Utah with wife, Judy and Australian Shepherds, Clancy and Molly.

title: Mastering Spark for Data Science
description:
Master the techniques and sophisticated analytics used to construct Spark-based solutions that scale to deliver production-grade data science products

About This Book

Develop and apply advanced analytical techniques with Spark

Learn how to tell a compelling story with data science using Spark’s ecosystem

Explore data at scale and work with cutting edge data science methods

Who This Book Is For

This book is for those who have beginner-level familiarity with the Spark architecture and data science applications, especially those who are looking for a challenge and want to learn cutting edge techniques. This book assumes working knowledge of data science, common machine learning methods, and popular data science tools, and assumes you have previously run proof of concept studies and built prototypes.

What You Will Learn

Learn the design patterns that integrate Spark into industrialized data science pipelines

See how commercial data scientists design scalable code and reusable code for data science services

Explore cutting edge data science methods so that you can study trends and causality

Discover advanced programming techniques using RDD and the DataFrame and Dataset APIs

Find out how Spark can be used as a universal ingestion engine tool and as a web scraper

Practice the implementation of advanced topics in graph processing, such as community detection and contact chaining

Get to know the best practices when performing Extended Exploratory Data Analysis, commonly used in commercial data science teams

Study advanced Spark concepts, solution design patterns, and integration architectures

Demonstrate powerful data science pipelines

In Detail

Data science seeks to transform the world using data, and this is typically achieved through disrupting and changing real processes in real industries. In order to operate at this level you need to build data science solutions of substance –solutions that solve real problems. Spark has emerged as the big data platform of choice for data scientists due to its speed, scalability, and easy-to-use APIs.

This book deep dives into using Spark to deliver production-grade data science solutions. This process is demonstrated by exploring the construction of a sophisticated global news analysis service that uses Spark to generate continuous geopolitical and current affairs insights.You will learn all about the core Spark APIs and take a comprehensive tour of advanced libraries, including Spark SQL, Spark Streaming, MLlib, and more.

You will be introduced to advanced techniques and methods that will help you to construct commercial-grade data products. Focusing on a sequence of tutorials that deliver a working news intelligence service, you will learn about advanced Spark architectures, how to work with geographic data in Spark, and how to tune Spark algorithms so they scale linearly.

Style and approach

This is an advanced guide for those with beginner-level familiarity with the Spark architecture and working with Data Science applications. Mastering Spark for Data Science is a practical tutorial that uses core Spark APIs and takes a deep dive into advanced libraries including: Spark SQL, visual streaming, and MLlib. This book expands on titles like: Machine Learning with Spark and Learning Spark. It is the next learning curve for those comfortable with Spark and looking to improve their skills.

Vea cómo los científicos de datos comerciales diseñan código escalable y código reutilizable para los servicios de ciencia de datos

En detalle

La ciencia de datos busca transformar el mundo utilizando datos, y esto se logra típicamente mediante la perturbación y el cambio de procesos reales en industrias reales. Para operar a este nivel es necesario construir soluciones de ciencia de datos de sustancia – soluciones que resuelvan problemas reales. Spark ha surgido como la gran plataforma de datos de elección para los científicos de datos debido a su velocidad, escalabilidad y API fáciles de usar.

Este libro inmersa profundamente en el uso de Spark para ofrecer soluciones de ciencia de datos de grado de producción. Este proceso se demuestra explorando la construcción de un sofisticado servicio global de análisis de noticias que utiliza Spark para generar ideas geopolíticas y actuales. Usted aprenderá todo sobre el núcleo de las API de Spark y tomar un recorrido completo de bibliotecas avanzadas, incluyendo Spark SQL, Spark Streaming, MLlib, y más.

Se le introducirá en técnicas y métodos avanzados que le ayudarán a construir productos de datos de grado comercial. Centrándose en una secuencia de tutoriales que ofrecen un servicio de inteligencia de noticias de trabajo, usted aprenderá sobre arquitecturas avanzadas de Spark, cómo trabajar con datos geográficos en Spark, y cómo sintonizar algoritmos de Spark para que escalan linealmente.

Estilo y enfoque

Esta es una guía avanzada para aquellos con familiaridad de primer nivel con la arquitectura Spark y trabajando con aplicaciones Data Science. Mastering Spark for Data Science es un tutorial práctico que utiliza API de Spark Core y toma una profunda inmersión en bibliotecas avanzadas incluyendo: Spark SQL, streaming visual y MLlib. Este libro se expande en títulos como: Machine Learning with Spark and Learning Spark. Es la siguiente curva de aprendizaje para aquellos cómodos con Spark y buscando mejorar sus habilidades.

Discussions to illustrate the concepts and highlight key fundamental computational skills that are utilized by business, government, and organizations alike

New chapters on reporting results in tables and factor analysis

Additional information on the DATA step for data management with an emphasis on importing data from other sources, combining data sets, and data cleaning

Updated ANOVA and regression examples as well as other data analysis techniques

A companion website with the discussed data sets, additional code, and related PowerPoint slides

SAS Essentials: Mastering SAS for Data Analytics, Second Edition is an ideal textbook for upper-undergraduate and graduate-level courses in statistics, data analytics, applied SAS programming, and statistical computer applications as well as an excellent supplement for statistical methodology courses. The book is an appropriate reference for researchers and academicians who require a basic introduction to SAS for statistical analysis and for preparation for the Basic SAS Certification Exam.
translatedDescription:

Teniendo en cuenta diferentes niveles de experiencia, el equipo de autor altamente cualificado ha desarrollado el libro durante 20 años de enseñanza de cursos SAS introductorios.

Dividido en dos secciones, la primera parte del libro proporciona una introducción a la manipulación de datos, técnicas estadísticas y el lenguaje de programación SAS. La segunda sección está diseñada para introducir a los usuarios en el análisis estadístico utilizando procedimientos SAS. Con capítulos independientes para mejorar el proceso de aprendizaje, la Segunda Edición también incluye:

Enfoques de programación para la versión más actualizada de la plataforma SAS incluyendo información sobre cómo utilizar la edición SAS University

Discusiones para ilustrar los conceptos y poner de relieve las principales habilidades computacionales fundamentales que son utilizadas por empresas, gobiernos y organizaciones por igual

Nuevos capítulos sobre los resultados de la presentación de informes en cuadros y análisis de factores

Información adicional sobre la medida DATA para la gestión de datos con énfasis en la importación de datos de otras fuentes, la combinación de conjuntos de datos y la limpieza de datos

Actualizado ANOVA y ejemplos de regresión, así como otras técnicas de análisis de datos

Un sitio web compañero con los conjuntos de datos discutidos, código adicional y diapositivas de PowerPoint relacionados

SAS Essentials: Mastering SAS for Data Analytics, Second Edition es un libro de texto ideal para cursos de alto grado y posgrado en estadística, análisis de datos, programación SAS aplicada y aplicaciones informáticas estadísticas, así como un excelente suplemento para cursos de metodología estadística. El libro es una referencia adecuada para investigadores y académicos que requieren una introducción básica a SAS para el análisis estadístico y para la preparación para el examen básico de certificación SAS.

title: Future-Proofing: Emerging AI Security Challenges
description: This video collection explores key security risks associated with generative AI. It's crucial for viewers to understand these risks as AI becomes more prevalent in daily life and business. The series addresses common concerns and misconceptions, equipping the audience with knowledge to identify, assess, and mitigate potential AI-related security threats in their personal and professional environments.
translatedDescription: Esta colección de vídeo explora los principales riesgos de seguridad asociados con la IA generativa. Es crucial que los espectadores entiendan estos riesgos ya que la IA se vuelve más prevalente en la vida diaria y en los negocios. La serie aborda preocupaciones comunes y conceptos erróneos, dotando al público de conocimientos para identificar, evaluar y mitigar posibles amenazas de seguridad relacionadas con la IA en sus entornos personales y profesionales.

title: Data Mining and Machine Learning in Cybersecurity
description: From basic concepts in machine learning and data mining to advanced problems in the machine learning domain, this book provides a unified reference for specific machine learning solutions to cybersecurity problems. It supplies a foundation in cybersecurity fundamentals, surveys contemporary challenges, and details cutting-edge machine learning and data mining techniques. This interdisciplinary resource includes technique review tables that allow for speedy access to common cybersecurity problems and associated data mining methods. Numerous illustrative figures and more than 40 case studies help readers visualize the workflow of complex techniques.
translatedDescription: Desde conceptos básicos en el aprendizaje automático y la minería de datos hasta problemas avanzados en el ámbito del aprendizaje automático, este libro proporciona una referencia unificada para soluciones específicas de aprendizaje automático a problemas de ciberseguridad. Proporciona una fundación en los fundamentos de la ciberseguridad, encuesta los desafíos contemporáneos y detalles de aprendizaje de máquinas de vanguardia y técnicas de extracción de datos. Este recurso interdisciplinario incluye tablas de revisión de técnicas que permiten un acceso rápido a problemas comunes de ciberseguridad y métodos asociados de extracción de datos. Numerosas figuras ilustrativas y más de 40 estudios de casos ayudan a los lectores a visualizar el flujo de trabajo de técnicas complejas.

title: Optimization and Machine Learning
description: Machine learning and optimization techniques are revolutionizing our world. Other types of information technology have not progressed as rapidly in recent years, in terms of real impact. The aim of this book is to present some of the innovative techniques in the field of optimization and machine learning, and to demonstrate how to apply them in the fields of engineering.Optimization and Machine Learning presents modern advances in the selection, configuration and engineering of algorithms that rely on machine learning and optimization. The first part of the book is dedicated to applications where optimization plays a major role, and the second part describes and implements several applications that are mainly based on machine learning techniques. The methods addressed in these chapters are compared against their competitors, and their effectiveness in their chosen field of application is illustrated.
translatedDescription: Las técnicas de aprendizaje y optimización de la máquina están revolucionando nuestro mundo. Otros tipos de tecnología de la información no han progresado tan rápidamente en los últimos años, en términos de impacto real. El objetivo de este libro es presentar algunas de las técnicas innovadoras en el campo de la optimización y el aprendizaje automático, y demostrar cómo aplicarlas en los campos de la ingeniería. Optimización y aprendizaje automático presenta avances modernos en la selección, configuración e ingeniería de algoritmos que dependen del aprendizaje automático y la optimización. La primera parte del libro se dedica a aplicaciones donde la optimización desempeña un papel importante, y la segunda parte describe e implementa varias aplicaciones que se basan principalmente en técnicas de aprendizaje automático. Los métodos abordados en estos capítulos se comparan con sus competidores, y su eficacia en su campo de aplicación elegido se ilustra.

title: Navigating Strategic Decisions
description: Based on forty years of experience and research, this book provides guidance on forecasting for strategic decision making. It includes methodology, tools, and models. It also explains how to apply sanity checks to existing forecasts to rank project valuations, identify project risks, and select the higher value creation projects. The author discusses how to assess the feasibility of large projects, analyze forecasting models to determine controllable levers, and create the conditions needed for forecasts to materialize.
translatedDescription: Basado en cuarenta años de experiencia e investigación, este libro proporciona orientación sobre pronósticos para la adopción de decisiones estratégicas. Incluye metodología, herramientas y modelos. También explica cómo aplicar controles de cordura a las previsiones existentes para clasificar las valoraciones de proyectos, identificar los riesgos de proyecto y seleccionar los proyectos de creación de valor más alto. El autor discute cómo evaluar la viabilidad de grandes proyectos, analizar modelos de pronóstico para determinar palancas controlables y crear las condiciones necesarias para que las previsiones se materialicen.

title: Business Analytics Principles, Concepts, and Applications with SAS: What, Why, and How
description:
Learn everything you need to know to start using business analytics and integrating it throughout your organization.

Business Analytics Principles, Concepts, and Applications with SAS brings together a complete, integrated package of knowledge for newcomers to the subject. The authors present an up-to-date view of what business analytics is, why it is so valuable, and most importantly, how it is used. They combine essential conceptual content with clear explanations of the tools, techniques, and methodologies actually used to implement modern business analytics initiatives.

They offer a proven step-wise approach to designing an analytics program, and successfully integrating it into your organization, so it effectively provides intelligence for competitive advantage in decision making.

Using step-by-step examples, the authors identify common challenges that can be addressed by business analytics, illustrate each type of analytics (descriptive, prescriptive, and predictive), and guide users in undertaking their own projects. Illustrating the real-world use of statistical, information systems, and management science methodologies, these examples help readers successfully apply the methods they are learning.

Unlike most competitive guides, this text demonstrates the use of SAS software, permitting instructors to spend less time teaching software and more time focusing on business analytics itself.

Business Analytics Principles, Concepts, and Applications with SAS will be a valuable resource for all beginning-to-intermediate level business analysts and business analytics managers; for MBA/Masters' degree students in the field; and for advanced undergraduates majoring in statistics, applied mathematics, or engineering/operations research.
translatedDescription:
Aprende todo lo que necesitas saber para empezar a usar análisis de negocios e integrarlo en toda tu organización.

Business Analytics Principles, Concepts, and Applications with SAS reúne un paquete completo e integrado de conocimientos para los recién llegados al tema. Los autores presentan una visión actualizada de lo que es el análisis de negocios, por qué es tan valioso, y lo más importante, cómo se utiliza. Combinan contenidos conceptuales esenciales con explicaciones claras de las herramientas, técnicas y metodologías utilizadas para implementar iniciativas modernas de análisis empresarial.

Ofrecen un enfoque basado en pasos comprobados para diseñar un programa de análisis, e integrarlo con éxito en su organización, por lo que proporciona inteligencia para la ventaja competitiva en la toma de decisiones.

Utilizando ejemplos paso a paso, los autores identifican desafíos comunes que pueden ser abordados por análisis de negocios, ilustran cada tipo de análisis (descriptivo, prescriptivo y predictivo) y guían a los usuarios en la realización de sus propios proyectos. Ilustrando el uso real de metodologías estadísticas, sistemas de información y ciencias de la gestión, estos ejemplos ayudan a los lectores a aplicar con éxito los métodos que están aprendiendo.

A diferencia de la mayoría de los guías competitivos, este texto demuestra el uso del software SAS, permitiendo a los instructores pasar menos tiempo enseñando software y más tiempo centrándose en el análisis de negocios en sí mismo.

Business Analytics Principles, Concepts, and Applications with SAS will be a valuable resource for all beginning-to-intermediate level business analytics managers; for MBA/Masters' degree students in the field; and for advanced undergraduates majoring in statistics, applied mathematics, or engineering/operations research.

title: Mastering Elastic Stack
description:
Mastering Elastic Stack is your complete guide to advancing your data analytics expertise using the ELK Stack. With detailed coverage of Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana, Beats, and X-Pack, this book equips you with the skills to process and analyze any type of data efficiently. Through practical examples and real-world scenarios, you'll gain the ability to build end-to-end pipelines and create insightful dashboards.

What this Book will help me do

Build and manage log pipelines using Logstash, Beats, and Elasticsearch for real-time analytics.
Develop advanced Kibana dashboards to visualize and interpret complex datasets.
Efficiently utilize X-Pack features for alerting, monitoring, and security in the Elastic Stack.
Master plugin customization and deployment for a tailored Elastic Stack environment.
Apply Elastic Stack solutions to real-world cases for centralized logging and actionable insights.

Author(s)

The authors, None Kumar Gupta and None Gupta, are experienced technologists who have spent years working at the forefront of data processing and analytics. They are well-versed in Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana, and the Elastic ecosystem, having worked extensively in enterprise environments where these tools have transformed operations. Their passion for teaching and thorough understanding of the tools culminate in this comprehensive resource.

Who is it for?

The ideal reader is a developer already familiar with Elasticsearch, Logstash, and Kibana who wants to deepen their understanding of the stack. If you're involved in creating scalable data pipelines, analyzing complex datasets, or looking to implement centralized logging solutions in your work, this book is an excellent resource. It bridges the gap from intermediate to expert knowledge, allowing you to use the Elastic Stack effectively in various scenarios. Whether you are transitioning from a beginner or enhancing your skill set, this book meets your needs.

title: Artificial Intelligence Now
description:
The past year or so has seen a true explosion in both the capabilities and adoption of artificial intelligence technologies. Today’s generalized AI tools can solve specific problems more powerfully than the complex rule-based tools that preceded them. And, because these new AI tools can be deployed in many contexts, more and more applications and industries are ripe for transformation with AI technologies.

By drawing from the best posts on the O’Reilly AI blog, this in-depth report summarizes the current state of AI technologies and applications, and provides useful guides to help you get started with deep learning and other AI tools.

In six distinct parts, this report covers:

The AI landscape: the platforms, businesses, and business models shaping AI growth; plus a look at the emerging AI stack
Technology: AI’s technical underpinnings and deep learning capabilities, tools, and tutorials
Homebuilt autonomous systems: "hobbyist" applications that showcase AI tools, libraries, cloud processing, and mobile computing
Natural language: strategies for scoping and tackling NLP projects
Use cases: an analysis of two of the leading-edge use cases for artificial intelligence—chat bots and autonomous vehicles
Integrating human and machine intelligence: development of human-AI hybrid applications and workflows; using AI to map and access large-scale knowledge databases
translatedDescription:
El año pasado ha visto una verdadera explosión tanto en las capacidades como en la adopción de tecnologías de inteligencia artificial. Las herramientas de AI generalizadas de hoy pueden resolver problemas específicos más poderosamente que las complejas herramientas basadas en reglas que las precedieron. Y, debido a que estas nuevas herramientas de IA se pueden implementar en muchos contextos, cada vez más aplicaciones e industrias están maduras para la transformación con tecnologías de IA.

A partir de los mejores posts del blog O’Reilly AI, este informe en profundidad resume el estado actual de las tecnologías y aplicaciones de AI, y proporciona guías útiles para ayudarle a comenzar con el aprendizaje profundo y otras herramientas de inteligencia artificial.

En seis partes distintas, el presente informe abarca:

El paisaje AI: las plataformas, empresas y modelos de negocio que conforman el crecimiento de IA; además de un vistazo a la pila de IA emergente
Tecnología: Los fundamentos técnicos de AI y las capacidades de aprendizaje profundo, herramientas y tutoriales
Sistemas autónomos caseros: aplicaciones "hobbyist" que muestran herramientas de IA, bibliotecas, procesamiento de nubes y computación móvil
Lenguaje natural: estrategias para analizar y abordar proyectos NLP
Casos de uso: un análisis de dos de los casos de uso de vanguardia para la inteligencia artificial: bots y vehículos autónomos
Integración de la inteligencia humana y de la máquina: desarrollo de aplicaciones híbridas y flujos de trabajo de la AI humana; utilización de la IA para mapear y acceder a bases de datos de conocimiento a gran escala

title: Good Charts Workbook
description:
Talk. Sketch. Prototype. Repeat.

You know right away when you see an effective chart or graphic. It hits you with an immediate sense of its meaning and impact. But what actually makes it clearer, sharper, and more effective? If you're ready to create your own "good charts"--data visualizations that powerfully communicate your ideas and research and that advance your career—the Good Charts Workbook is the hands-on guide you've been looking for.

The original Good Charts changed the landscape by helping readers understand how to think visually and by laying out a process for creating powerful data visualizations. Now, the Good Charts Workbook provides tools, exercises, and practical insights to help people in all kinds of enterprises gain the skills they need to get started.

Harvard Business Review Senior Editor and dataviz expert Scott Berinato leads you, step-by-step, through the key challenges in creating good charts—controlling color, crafting for clarity, choosing chart types, practicing persuasion, capturing concepts—with warm-up exercises and mini-challenges for each. The Workbook includes helpful prompts and reminders throughout, as well as white space for users to practice the Good Charts talk-sketch-prototype process.

Good Charts Workbook is the must-have manual for better understanding the dataviz around you and for creating better charts to make your case more effectively.

Habla. Sketch. Prototipo. Repito.

Si usted está listo para crear sus propios "buenos gráficos" - visualizaciones de datos que comunican poderosamente sus ideas e investigación y que avancen su carrera - el libro de trabajo de Good Charts es la guía práctica que ha estado buscando.

Los Good Charts originales cambiaron el paisaje ayudando a los lectores a entender cómo pensar visualmente y estableciendo un proceso para crear potentes visualizaciones de datos. El Cuaderno de Trabajo incluye impulsos y recordatorios útiles a lo largo de todo, así como espacio blanco para que los usuarios practiquen el proceso de habla de Good Charts.

Good Charts Workbook es el manual que debe tener para entender mejor el dataviz a su alrededor y para crear mejores gráficos para que su caso sea más eficaz.

title: Machine Learning with Go Quick Start Guide
description:
Machine Learning with Go Quick Start Guide is your gateway to building machine learning workflows using Go. You'll discover supervised and unsupervised learning techniques, dive into data preprocessing and modeling, and explore how to deploy machine learning applications effectively. Empower yourself with the ability to integrate ML into Go projects seamlessly.

Understand the fundamental principles of machine learning and its problem-solving techniques.
Learn how to preprocess, explore, and visualize data in Go.
Build supervised and unsupervised learning models using Go libraries such as GoML.
Develop skills to evaluate and troubleshoot machine learning models effectively.

title: Business Case Analysis with R: Simulation Tutorials to Support Complex Business Decisions
description:
This tutorial teaches you how to use the statistical programming language R to develop a business case simulation and analysis. It presents a methodology for conducting business case analysis that minimizes decision delay by focusing stakeholders on what matters most and suggests pathways for minimizing the risk in strategic and capital allocation decisions. Business case analysis, often conducted in spreadsheets, exposes decision makers to additional risks that arise just from the use of the spreadsheet environment.

R has become one of the most widely used tools for reproducible quantitative analysis, and analysts fluent in this language are in high demand. The R language, traditionally used for statistical analysis, provides a more explicit, flexible, and extensible environment than spreadsheets for conducting business case analysis.

The main tutorial follows the case in which a chemical manufacturing company considers constructing a chemical reactor and production facility to bring a new compound to market. There are numerous uncertainties and risks involved, including the possibility that a competitor brings a similar product online. The company must determine the value of making the decision to move forward and where they might prioritize their attention to make a more informed and robust decision. While the example used is a chemical company, the analysis structure it presents can be applied to just about any business decision, from IT projects to new product development to commercial real estate. The supporting tutorials include the perspective of the founder of a professional service firm who wants to grow his business and a member of a strategic planning group in a biomedical device company who wants to know how much to budget in order to refine the quality of information about critical uncertainties that might affect the value of a chosen product development pathway.

What You’ll Learn

Set upa business case abstraction in an influence diagram to communicate the essence of the problem to other stakeholders
Model the inherent uncertainties in the problem with Monte Carlo simulation using the R language
Communicate the results graphically
Draw appropriate insights from the results
Develop creative decision strategies for thorough opportunity cost analysis
Calculate the value of information on critical uncertainties between competing decision strategies to set the budget for deeper data analysis
Construct appropriate information to satisfy the parameters for the Monte Carlo simulation when little or no empirical data are available

Who This Book Is For

Financial analysts, data practitioners, and risk/business professionals; also appropriate for graduate level finance, business, or data science students
translatedDescription:
Este tutorial le enseña cómo utilizar el lenguaje de programación estadística R para desarrollar una simulación y análisis de caso empresarial. Presenta una metodología para la realización de análisis de casos empresariales que reduce al mínimo las demoras en la adopción de decisiones centrando a los interesados en lo que más importa y sugiere vías para reducir al mínimo el riesgo en las decisiones de asignación estratégica y de capital. El análisis de casos comerciales, realizado a menudo en hojas de cálculo, expone a los encargados de adoptar decisiones a riesgos adicionales que surgen sólo del uso del entorno de hoja de cálculo.

R se ha convertido en una de las herramientas más utilizadas para el análisis cuantitativo reproducible, y los analistas fluidos en este lenguaje son de alta demanda. El lenguaje R, tradicionalmente utilizado para el análisis estadístico, proporciona un entorno más explícito, flexible y extensible que hojas de cálculo para la realización de análisis de casos comerciales.

El tutorial principal sigue el caso en que una empresa de fabricación química considera construir un reactor químico y una instalación de producción para llevar un nuevo compuesto al mercado. Hay numerosas incertidumbres y riesgos involucrados, incluyendo la posibilidad de que un competidor traiga un producto similar en línea. La empresa debe determinar el valor de tomar la decisión de avanzar y dónde priorizar su atención para tomar una decisión más informada y robusta. Si bien el ejemplo utilizado es una empresa química, la estructura de análisis que presenta se puede aplicar a casi cualquier decisión de negocio, desde proyectos de TI hasta el desarrollo de nuevos productos a bienes raíces comerciales. Los tutoriales de apoyo incluyen la perspectiva del fundador de una empresa de servicios profesionales que quiere crecer su negocio y un miembro de un grupo de planificación estratégica en una empresa de dispositivos biomédicos que quiere saber cuánto presupuesto para refinar la calidad de la información sobre incertidumbres críticas que podrían afectar el valor de una ruta de desarrollo de productos elegida.

Lo que aprenderás

Establecer una abstracción de caso de negocio en un diagrama de influencia para comunicar la esencia del problema a otros interesados
Modelar las incertidumbres inherentes en el problema con la simulación de Monte Carlo utilizando el lenguaje R
Comunicar los resultados gráficamente
Dibujar información apropiada de los resultados
Elaborar estrategias de decisión creativas para un análisis minucioso de los costos de oportunidad
Calcular el valor de la información sobre las incertidumbres críticas entre las estrategias de decisión competitivas para establecer el presupuesto para un análisis más profundo de los datos
Construir la información adecuada para satisfacer los parámetros de la simulación de Monte Carlo cuando se disponga de poco o ningún dato empírico

Quién es este libro

It also includes column names and descriptions for each of the tables and views, as well as helpful tips, warnings, and usage examples.O'Reilly's Pocket References have become a favorite among developers and database administrators everywhere. By providing a wealth of important details in a concise, well-organized format, these handy books deliver just what you need to complete the task at hand. When you've reached a sticking point in your work and want to check your facts quickly, the Oracle Data Dictionary Pocket Reference is the book to have close by.

title: Data Analysis and Applications 1
description: This series of books collects a diverse array of work that provides the reader with theoretical and applied information on data analysis methods, models, and techniques, along with appropriate applications.Volume 1 begins with an introductory chapter by Gilbert Saporta, a leading expert in the field, who summarizes the developments in data analysis over the last 50 years. The book is then divided into three parts: Part 1 presents clustering and regression cases; Part 2 examines grouping and decomposition, GARCH and threshold models, structural equations, and SME modeling; and Part 3 presents symbolic data analysis, time series and multiple choice models, modeling in demography, and data mining.

El volumen 1 comienza con un capítulo introductorio de Gilbert Saporta, un experto líder en el campo, que resume los avances en el análisis de datos en los últimos 50 años. El libro se divide en tres partes: la Parte 1 presenta casos de agrupación y regresión; En la parte 2 se examina la agrupación y descomposición, los modelos GARCH y umbral, las ecuaciones estructurales y el modelado de PYME; y en la parte 3 se presentan análisis simbólicos de datos, series temporales y modelos de selección múltiple, modelado en demografía y extracción de datos.

description:
Demystifying the power of the Oracle 12c database

The Oracle database is the industry-leading relational database management system (RDMS) used from small companies to the world's largest enterprises alike for their most critical business and analytical processing. Oracle 12c includes industry leading enhancements to enable cloud computing and empowers users to manage both Big Data and traditional data structures faster and cheaper than ever before. Oracle 12c For Dummies is the perfect guide for a novice database administrator or an Oracle DBA who is new to Oracle 12c. The book covers what you need to know about Oracle 12c architecture, software tools, and how to successfully manage Oracle databases in the real world.

Highlights the important features of Oracle 12c

Explains how to create, populate, protect, tune, and troubleshoot a new Oracle database

Covers advanced Oracle 12c technologies including Oracle Multitenant—the “pluggable database” concept—as well as several other key changes in this release

Make the most of Oracle 12c's improved efficiency, stronger security, and simplified management capabilities with Oracle 12c For Dummies.

Oracle 12c incluye mejoras líderes de la industria para permitir la computación de la nube y capacita a los usuarios para gestionar Big Data y estructuras de datos tradicionales más rápido y más barato que nunca. title: Practical Neural Network Recipies in C++
description: This text serves as a cookbook for neural network solutions to practical problems using C++. It will enable those with moderate programming experience to select a neural network model appropriate to solving a particular problem, and to produce a working program implementing that network. The book provides guidance along the entire problem-solving path, including designing the training set, preprocessing variables, training and validating the network, and evaluating its performance. Though the book is not intended as a general course in neural networks, no background in neural works is assumed and all models are presented from the ground up.The principle focus of the book is the three layer feedforward network, for more than a decade as the workhorse of professional arsenals. Other network models with strong performance records are also included.Bound in the book is an IBM diskette that includes the source code for all programs in the book. Much of this code can be easily adapted to C compilers. In addition, the operation of all programs is thoroughly discussed both in the text and in the comments within the code to facilitate translation to other languages.
translatedDescription: Este texto sirve como libro de cocina para soluciones de red neuronal a problemas prácticos utilizando C++. Permitirá a aquellos con experiencia de programación moderada seleccionar un modelo de red neuronal apropiado para resolver un problema particular, y producir un programa de trabajo que implemente esa red. El libro proporciona orientación a lo largo de todo el camino de solución de problemas, incluyendo el diseño del conjunto de capacitación, las variables de preprocesamiento, la capacitación y validación de la red, y la evaluación de su desempeño. Aunque el libro no está pensado como un curso general en redes neuronales, no se asume ningún fondo en obras neuronales y todos los modelos se presentan desde el suelo. El objetivo principal del libro es la red de tres capas hacia adelante, durante más de una década como el caballo de trabajo de los arsenales profesionales. También se incluyen otros modelos de red con registros de rendimiento sólidos. Libra en el libro es un disco IBM que incluye el código fuente para todos los programas del libro. Gran parte de este código se puede adaptar fácilmente a los compiladores C. Además, el funcionamiento de todos los programas se discute a fondo tanto en el texto como en los comentarios dentro del código para facilitar la traducción a otros idiomas.

title: Techniques of Model-Based Control
description:

In Techniques of Model-Based Control, two leading experts bring together powerful advances in model-based control for chemical-process engineering. Coleman Brosilow and Babu Joseph focus on practical approaches designed to solve real-world problems, and they offer extensive examples and exercises.

Coverage includes:

The nature of the process-control problem and how model-based solutions help to solve it

Continuous time modeling: time domain, Laplace domain, and FOPDT models

Feedforward, cascade, override, and single-variable inferential control approaches

One and two degree of freedom Internal Model Control

Model State Feedback and PI/PID Implementations of IMC

Tuning and synthesis of 1DF and 2DF IMC for process uncertainty

Estimation and inferential control using multiple secondary measurements

Basic and advanced techniques of model identification and model-predictive control

From start to finish, Techniques of Model-Based Control offers the real-world insight that professionals need to identify and implement the best control strategies for virtually any process.

title: Enterprise Service Bus
description: Large IT organizations increasingly face the challenge of integrating various web services, applications, and other technologies into a single network. The solution to finding a meaningful large-scale architecture that is capable of spanning a global enterprise appears to have been met in ESB, or Enterprise Service Bus. Rather than conform to the hub-and-spoke architecture of traditional enterprise application integration products, ESB provides a highly distributed approach to integration, with unique capabilities that allow individual departments or business units to build out their integration projects in incremental, digestible chunks, maintaining their own local control and autonomy, while still being able to connect together each integration project into a larger, more global integration fabric, or grid.Enterprise Service Bus offers a thorough introduction and overview for systems architects, system integrators, technical project leads, and CTO/CIO level managers who need to understand, assess, and evaluate this new approach. Written by Dave Chappell, one of the best known and authoritative voices in the field of enterprise middleware and standards-based integration, the book drills down into the technical details of the major components of ESB, showing how it can utilize an event-driven SOA to bring a variety of enterprise applications and services built on J2EE, .NET, C/C++, and other legacy environments into the reach of the everyday IT professional.With Enterprise Service Bus, readers become well versed in the problems faced by IT organizations today, gaining an understanding of how current technology deficiencies impact business issues. Through the study of real-world use cases and integration patterns drawn from several industries using ESB--including Telcos, financial services, retail, B2B exchanges, energy, manufacturing, and more--the book clearly and coherently outlines the benefits of moving toward this integration strategy. The book also compares ESB to other integration architectures, contrasting their inherent strengths and limitations.If you are charged with understanding, assessing, or implementing an integration architecture, Enterprise Service Bus will provide the straightforward information you need to draw your conclusions about this important disruptive technology.
translatedDescription: Las grandes organizaciones de TI afrontan cada vez más el desafío de integrar diversos servicios web, aplicaciones y otras tecnologías en una sola red. La solución para encontrar una arquitectura significativa a gran escala capaz de abarcar una empresa global parece haberse encontrado en ESB o Enterprise Service Bus. En lugar de conformarse con la arquitectura central de los productos tradicionales de integración de aplicaciones empresariales, ESB proporciona un enfoque altamente distribuido a la integración, con capacidades únicas que permiten a departamentos individuales o unidades de negocio construir sus proyectos de integración en trozos incrementales, digestibles, manteniendo su propio control local y autonomía, al mismo tiempo poder conectar cada proyecto de integración en un tejido de integración más grande, más global o rejilla. Enterprise Service Bus ofrece una introducción completa y una visión general para arquitectos de sistemas, integradores de sistemas, guías de proyectos técnicos, y administradores de nivel CTO/CIO que necesitan entender, evaluar y evaluar este nuevo enfoque. Escrito por Dave Chappell, una de las voces más conocidas y autoritativas en el campo de la integración empresarial y basada en estándares, el libro se perfora en los detalles técnicos de los principales componentes de ESB, mostrando cómo puede utilizar un SOA impulsado por eventos para traer una variedad de aplicaciones y servicios empresariales construidos en J2EE, .NET, C/C+++ y otros entornos heredados al alcance del profesional de TI cotidiano. Con Enterprise Service Bus, los lectores se ven bien versados en los problemas que enfrentan las organizaciones de TI hoy, adquiriendo una comprensión de cómo las deficiencias tecnológicas actuales afectan los problemas de negocio. Mediante el estudio de casos de uso real y patrones de integración elaborados por varias industrias utilizando ESB, incluyendo Telcos, servicios financieros, retail, intercambios B2B, energía, fabricación y más, el libro describe claramente y coherentemente los beneficios de avanzar hacia esta estrategia de integración. El libro también compara ESB con otras arquitecturas de integración, contrastando sus fortalezas y limitaciones inherentes. Si usted está encargado de entender, evaluar o implementar una arquitectura de integración, Enterprise Service Bus proporcionará la información directa que necesita para sacar sus conclusiones sobre esta importante tecnología disruptiva.

With examples of real-life research problems, it emphasizes sound research designs, appropriate statistical analyses, and accurate interpretations of results.

title: GARCH Models
description:
This book provides a comprehensive and systematic approach to understanding GARCH time series models and their applications whilst presenting the most advanced results concerning the theory and practical aspects of GARCH. The probability structure of standard GARCH models is studied in detail as well as statistical inference such as identification, estimation and tests. The book also provides coverage of several extensions such as asymmetric and multivariate models and looks at financial applications.

Key features:

Provides up-to-date coverage of the current research in the probability, statistics and econometric theory of GARCH models.
Numerous illustrations and applications to real financial series are provided.
Supporting website featuring R codes, Fortran programs and data sets.
Presents a large collection of problems and exercises.

This authoritative, state-of-the-art reference is ideal for graduate students, researchers and practitioners in business and finance seeking to broaden their skills of understanding of econometric time series models.
translatedDescription:
Este libro proporciona un enfoque integral y sistemático para entender los modelos de series temporales de GARCH y sus aplicaciones, presentando los resultados más avanzados sobre la teoría y aspectos prácticos de GARCH. La estructura de probabilidad de los modelos estándar GARCH se estudia en detalle, así como la inferencia estadística como identificación, estimación y pruebas. El libro también proporciona cobertura de varias extensiones tales como modelos asimétricos y multivariados y examina las aplicaciones financieras.

Características clave:

Proporciona cobertura actualizada de la investigación actual en la probabilidad, estadísticas y teoría econométrica de los modelos GARCH.
Se proporcionan numerosas ilustraciones y aplicaciones a series financieras reales.
Sitio web de apoyo con códigos R, programas Fortran y conjuntos de datos.
Presenta una gran colección de problemas y ejercicios.

Esta referencia autorizada y de vanguardia es ideal para estudiantes graduados, investigadores y profesionales en negocios y finanzas que buscan ampliar sus habilidades de comprensión de los modelos de series temporales econométricas.

title: Using Flume
description:
How can you get your data from frontend servers to Hadoop in near real time? With this complete reference guide, you’ll learn Flume’s rich set of features for collecting, aggregating, and writing large amounts of streaming data to the Hadoop Distributed File System (HDFS), Apache HBase, SolrCloud, Elastic Search, and other systems.

Using Flume shows operations engineers how to configure, deploy, and monitor a Flume cluster, and teaches developers how to write Flume plugins and custom components for their specific use-cases. You’ll learn about Flume’s design and implementation, as well as various features that make it highly scalable, flexible, and reliable. Code examples and exercises are available on GitHub.

Learn how Flume provides a steady rate of flow by acting as a buffer between data producers and consumers
Dive into key Flume components, including sources that accept data and sinks that write and deliver it
Write custom plugins to customize the way Flume receives, modifies, formats, and writes data
Explore APIs for sending data to Flume agents from your own applications
Plan and deploy Flume in a scalable and flexible way—and monitor your cluster once it’s running

Utilizando Flume muestra a los ingenieros de operaciones cómo configurar, desplegar y monitorear un cluster Flume, y enseña a los desarrolladores cómo escribir plugins Flume y componentes personalizados para sus casos de uso específicos. title: Windows Store App Development: C# and XAML
description:

Following numerous carefully crafted examples, you'll learn about new Windows 8 features, the WinRT API, and .NET 4.5. Along the way, you'll pick up tips for deploying apps, including sale through the Windows Store. And, of course, you'll find the same deep and unique insights Pete provides in his Silverlight books.

The Windows Store provides an amazing array of productivity tools, games, and other apps directly to the millions of customers already using Windows 8.x or Surface. Windows Store apps boast new features like touch and pen input, standardized app-to-app communication, and tight integration with the web. And, you can build Windows Store apps using the tools you already know: C# and XAML.

Windows Store App Development introduces the Windows 8.x app model to readers familiar with traditional desktop development. You'll explore dozens of carefully crafted examples as you master Windows features, the Windows Runtime, and the best practices of app design. Along the way, you'll pick up tips for deploying apps, including selling through the Windows Store.

What's Inside
Designing, creating, and selling Windows Store apps

Working C# examples, from feature-level techniques to complete app design

Pete Brown is a Developer Evangelist at Microsoft and author of Silverlight 4 in Action and Silverlight 5 in Action.

title: An Introduction to Discrete-Valued Time Series
description:
A much-needed introduction to the field of discrete-valued time series, with a focus on count-data time series

Time series analysis is an essential tool in a wide array of fields, including business, economics, computer science, epidemiology, finance, manufacturing and meteorology, to name just a few. Despite growing interest in discrete-valued time series—especially those arising from counting specific objects or events at specified times—most books on time series give short shrift to that increasingly important subject area. This book seeks to rectify that state of affairs by providing a much needed introduction to discrete-valued time series, with particular focus on count-data time series.

The main focus of this book is on modeling. Throughout numerous examples are provided illustrating models currently used in discrete-valued time series applications. Statistical process control, including various control charts (such as cumulative sum control charts), and performance evaluation are treated at length. Classic approaches like ARMA models and the Box-Jenkins program are also featured with the basics of these approaches summarized in an Appendix. In addition, data examples, with all relevant R code, are available on a companion website.

Provides a balanced presentation of theory and practice, exploring both categorical and integer-valued series
Covers common models for time series of counts as well as for categorical time series,
and works out their most important stochastic properties
Addresses statistical approaches for analyzing discrete-valued time series and illustrates their implementation with numerous data examples
Covers classical approaches such as ARMA models, Box-Jenkins program and how to generate functions
Includes dataset examples with all necessary R code provided on a companion website

An Introduction to Discrete-Valued Time Series is a valuable working resource for researchers and practitioners in a broad range of fields, including statistics, data science, machine learning, and engineering. It will also be of interest to postgraduate students in statistics, mathematics and economics.
translatedDescription:
Una introducción muy necesaria al campo de las series temporales de valor discreto, con un enfoque en las series de tiempo contable-data

El análisis de series temporales es una herramienta esencial en una amplia gama de campos, incluyendo negocios, economía, informática, epidemiología, finanzas, fabricación y meteorología, para nombrar sólo unos pocos. A pesar del creciente interés en series temporales de valor discreto —especialmente las que se derivan de contar objetos o eventos específicos en momentos específicos—, la mayoría de los libros de la serie de tiempo dan cortos giros a esa área temática cada vez más importante. Este libro busca rectificar esa situación proporcionando una introducción muy necesaria a la serie temporal de valor discreto, con especial atención a la serie de tiempo contable.

El objetivo principal de este libro es modelar. A lo largo de numerosos ejemplos se proporcionan modelos ilustrativos utilizados actualmente en aplicaciones de series temporales de valor discreto. El control estadístico del proceso, incluyendo varios diagramas de control (como gráficos de control de sumas acumulativas), y la evaluación del desempeño se tratan a largo plazo. Los enfoques clásicos como los modelos ARMA y el programa Box-Jenkins también se presentan con los fundamentos de estos enfoques resumidos en un Apéndice. Además, los ejemplos de datos, con todo el código R pertinente, están disponibles en un sitio web de acompañantes.

Proporciona una presentación equilibrada de la teoría y la práctica, explorando series clasificadas y valoradas por entero
Cubre modelos comunes para series de tiempo y para series de tiempo clasificadas,
y trabaja sus propiedades estocásticas más importantes
Aborda los enfoques estadísticos para analizar series temporales de valor discreto e ilustra su aplicación con numerosos ejemplos de datos
Cubre enfoques clásicos como los modelos ARMA, el programa Box-Jenkins y cómo generar funciones
Incluye ejemplos de conjunto de datos con todo el código R necesario proporcionado en un sitio web compañero

An Introduction to Discrete-Valued Time Series es un valioso recurso de trabajo para investigadores y profesionales en una amplia gama de campos, incluyendo estadísticas, ciencias de datos, aprendizaje automático e ingeniería. También será de interés para los estudiantes de posgrado en estadísticas, matemáticas y economía.

title: Data Visualization Toolkit: Using JavaScript, Rails™, and Postgres to Present Data and Geospatial Information
description:
Create Beautiful Visualizations that Free Your Data to Tell Powerful Truths

“The depth of Barrett Clark’s knowledge shines through in his writing: clear, concise, and confident. Barrett has been practicing all of this stuff in his day job for many years–Postgres, D3, GIS, all of it. The knowledge in this book is real-world and hard-earned!” –From the Foreword by Obie Fernandez

Data Visualization Toolkit is your hands-on, practical, and holistic guide to the art of visualizing data. You’ll learn how to use Rails, jQuery, D3, Leaflet, PostgreSQL, and PostGIS together, creating beautiful visualizations and maps that give your data a voice and to make it “dance.”

Barrett Clark teaches through real-world problems and examples developed specifically to illuminate every technique you need to generate stunningly effective visualizations. You’ll move from the absolute basics toward deep dives, mastering diverse visualizations and discovering when to use each. Along the way, you’ll build three start-to-finish visualization applications, using actual real estate, weather, and travel datasets.

Clark addresses every component of data visualization: your data, database, application server, visualization libraries, and more. He explains data transformations; presents expert techniques in JavaScript, Ruby, and SQL; and illuminates key concepts associated with both descriptive statistics and geospatial data. Throughout, everything is aimed at one goal: to help you cut through the clutter and let your data tell all it can.

This guide will help you

Explore and understand the data visualization technology stack

Master the thought process and steps involved in importing data

Extract, transform, and load data in usable, reliable form

Handle spotty data, or data that doesn’t line up with what your chart expects

Use D3 to build pie and bar charts, scatter and box plots, and more

Work effectively with time-series data

Tweak Ruby and SQL to optimize performance with large datasets

Use raw SQL in Rails: window functions, subqueries, and common table expressions

Build chord diagrams and time-series aggregates

Use separate databases or schema for reporting databases

Integrate geographical data via geospatial SQL queries

Construct maps with Leaflet and Rails

Query geospatial data the “Rails way” and the “raw SQL way”

El conocimiento en este libro es mundo real y duramente ganado!” –De la prólogo de Obie Fernandez

Data Visualization Toolkit es su guía práctica, práctica y holística al arte de visualizar datos. Aprenderás a usar Rails, jQuery, D3, Leaflet, PostgreSQL y PostGIS juntos, creando hermosas visualizaciones y mapas que dan a tus datos una voz y hacerla “dance”.

Barrett Clark enseña a través de problemas y ejemplos reales desarrollados específicamente para iluminar cada técnica que necesita para generar visualizaciones impresionantemente efectivas. Usted se moverá de los fundamentos absolutos hacia profundas inmersiones, dominando diversas visualizaciones y descubriendo cuándo utilizar cada uno. A lo largo del camino, construirás tres aplicaciones de visualización de inicio a fin, utilizando conjuntos de datos de bienes raíces, clima y viaje.

Clark aborda cada componente de visualización de datos: sus datos, bases de datos, servidor de aplicaciones, bibliotecas de visualización y más. Explica las transformaciones de datos; presenta técnicas expertas en JavaScript, Ruby y SQL; e ilumina conceptos clave asociados con estadísticas descriptivas y datos geoespaciales. A lo largo, todo está dirigido a una meta: para ayudarle a cortar el desorden y dejar que sus datos digan todo lo que puede.

Esta guía te ayudará.

Explore y comprenda la pila de tecnología de visualización de datos

Dominar el proceso de pensamiento y los pasos que implica la importación de datos

Extraer, transformar y cargar datos en forma utilizable y fiable

Maneja datos de identificación, o datos que no se alinean con lo que su gráfico espera

Utilice D3 para construir cartas de pie y bar, dispersión y parcelas de caja, y más

Trabajar eficazmente con los datos de las series temporales

Tweak Ruby y SQL para optimizar el rendimiento con grandes conjuntos de datos

Use SQL crudo en Rails: funciones de ventana, subqueries y expresiones de mesa comunes

Construir diagramas de acordes y agregados de series temporales

Utilizar bases de datos o esquemas separados para la presentación de datos

Integrar datos geográficos mediante consultas SQL geoespaciales

Construir mapas con Leaflet y Rails

Consulta de datos geoespaciales el “Rails way” y el “raw SQL way”

title: Python Web Scraping
description:
Explore the possibilities of web scraping using Python with this practical guide. The book provides a comprehensive introduction to extracting information from web pages, managing complex scraping scenarios, and utilizing specialized tools such as Scrapy. Whether you're dealing with static pages or interactive web content, this book equips you with the skills to gather and process web data efficiently.

What this Book will help me do

Gain proficiency in writing Python scripts to extract data from web pages.
Learn to build and manage multithreaded crawlers to handle large-scale scraping tasks.
Master techniques for interacting with dynamic web content and JavaScript-rendered pages.
Understand how to work with web forms, sessions, and tackle challenges like CAPTCHA.
Implement practical examples of web scraping using Scrapy for real-world data projects.

Author(s)

Richard Penman is an experienced software engineer and an expert in Python programming and web development. With years of practical expertise in web crawling and data extraction, Richard shares his extensive knowledge in this field to make complex tasks accessible to developers of all levels. Who is it for?

This book is ideal for developers and technical professionals who want to learn effective techniques for web scraping with Python. A basic understanding of programming concepts and experience with Python will help readers get the most out of the practical examples. It's also suitable for advanced learners looking to apply Python skills for automating web data extraction tasks. If you're enthusiastic about turning web data into actionable insights, this guide is for you.

title: The Google Way
description:
Shortly after World War I, Ford and GM created the large modern corporation, with its financial and statistical controls, mass production, and assembly lines. In the 1980s, Toyota stood out for combining quality with continuous refinement. Today, Google is reinventing business yet again-the way we work, how organizations are controlled, and how employees are managed.

Management consultant Bernard Girard has been analyzing Google since its founding in 1998, and now in The Google Way, he explores Google's innovations in depth-many of which are far removed from the best practices taught at the top business schools.

As you read, you'll see how much of Google's success is due to its focus on users and automation. You'll also learn how eCommerce has profoundly changed the relationship between businesses and their customers, for the first time giving customers an important role to play in a major corporation's growth. Finally, Girard speculates about the limits of Google's business model and discusses the challenges it will face as it continues to grow.

Google's culture is one of innovation. Why not make that spirit of innovation your own?
translatedDescription:
